native_units: Uppercase lookup reads BYTE case_map[character] with unit stride; lead-byte test uses lowBYTE of character>>8
Multibyte search tests fullDWORD enabled flag and compares fullDWORD requested character; disabled strchr path consumes lowBYTE only
Case-insensitive collation forwards fullDWORD locale/codepage/count and retains native count0 early return, failureINT_MAX and wrap32 subtraction
Wide-character conversion tests fullDWORD CTYPE handle and reads lowWORD WCHAR, fullDWORD codepage/capacity and BOOL/error words
Timezone uses exact172-byte TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION: WORD month tests, DWORD bias values, full pointers, BYTE target name[3]/[63] stores

physical_frames.uppercase: PUSH EBP then PUSH ECX gives output cell at entryESP-8; actual incoming ECX retained for partial child writes; incoming argument bytes2/3 are mutated
physical_frames.wide_character: Output BOOL aliases first incoming argument DWORD at entryESP+4, zeroed only on native locale branch; WCHAR input at entryESP+8
physical_frames.timezone: First PUSH ECX at entryESP-4 owns BOOL output; same slot reused without initialization across both conversions
physical_frames.find_character: Zero-local native parent with read-only original argument words; separate C-body call prevents char-tailcall rewriting those words.

logical_results: Uppercase returns completeDWORD original value or zeroextended BYTE/assembled WORD; partial NLS output can consume realECX byte8..15
Wide conversion returns full count0/1/API count orffffffff and stores errno42 only on native error branch
Search returns full pointer; comparison returns full signedDWORD; timezone remains logicalvoid based known direct caller
timezone_order: Initial FROM_OS0/cache-marker ffffffff stores remain before empty/same TZ earlyreturns
Name pointers are reloaded after callbacks for BYTE terminators
TZ offset arithmetic wraps32; TZ branch retains previous daylight-seconds; DST suffix BYTE signextends to original DWORD
limitations: ECX capture preserves actual entry value, not an invented zero or public argument; transport across all reconstructed caller paths remains for the joint gate
Existing getenv and string/allocator/NLS helpers remain separate owners; getenv BYTE-global defects are a later concrete dependency
Partial outputs and aliasing are modeled at native physical cells; malformed arbitrary API writes or asynchronous interleavings remain unqualified
